articles.title_en: Vladislav Balgrabsky surrendered to save five soldiers under his command. Now Russia is putting him on trial for treason.
articles.lead_en: The criminal case against Vladislav Balgrabsky, a 30-year-old who fought in the war, has reached the 2nd Western District Military Court, the independent Russian outlet Mediazona reported. He is charged with voluntarily surrendering to the enemy, desertion, and treason.
